state: SCREENING — §2-2(4) OVERVIEW, NOT A COMPLIANCE STATEMENT

rows.evidence: The class is fixed by the regulation and does not depend on the site; whether the site is in it does. Flood datum and freeboard are the site inputs (cribado-riesgos-naturales.md)
Quick-clay regime below the marine limit is a siting gate, not a design value; no ground investigation exists
The reclaimed timber has no documented compliance instrument; §2-3(1)'s guidance names prøvning as the route, so this is a testing question (verificacion-instalaciones.md)
Area limbs unreachable at 18 m²; the tonnage limb is crossed only by aggregation with a demolition, so the duty applies iff the project dismantles a source building
Applies if a stove is fitted, which the room-sealed decision (row 14) makes more likely, not less
No. 4 overrides Table 1's R 30 for BKL 1 + risk class 4. A 48 mm rafter keeps 32 % of its modulus under charring; parity needs 98 mm stock (determinacion-cubierta-incendio.md)

rows.closed_by: whether a technical cupboard is a fire cell (S024 records it as open)
rows.evidence: One dwelling unit in one cell; the open question is whether the technical cupboard must be separated
B-s1,d0 applies only inside a rømningsvei. A cell with no rømningsvei is still a cell, so D-s2,d0 governs and the reclaimed timber stays exposed (determinacion-estrategia-incendio.md)
A product property of the standing-seam sheet, not a design value
V-03 gives 500 × 500, sum 1000. The deficit is −500 mm on the sum rule, the largest dimensional gap in the project (verificacion-ventanas.md)
V-03 at 1500 mm, V-02 at 1100; V-01 alone qualifies at 900 mm

rows.ytelse: Door free width in a rømningsvei
rows.closed_by: a door schedule with the free width dimensioned
rows.evidence: A 900 mm leaf is not a free width; ordinary sets spend 30–60 mm on frame, hinge and stop, and none is specified
A specification item with no dimensional consequence, which is why it has not been written yet
Both are properties of the pitch, not of the module
1778 mm at the eave at 20° / 1100 mm stack, so −422 mm. §12-7(2)(a)'s 2.4 m is exempt; (2)(c) sets 2.2 m for this building type (verificacion-altura-libre.md)

rows.ytelse: Relief for parts of a room
rows.evidence: Parts of the room may be lower «der dette ikke påvirker rommets bruksformål». How much is a determination, not a number, so it cannot be measured — only argued

rows.ytelse: Ventilation adapted to the pollution load
rows.closed_by: a room-sealed stove (row 14) and the make-up air inlet
rows.evidence: The quantities are produced — 52 m³/h governing supply, 90 basic and 108–216 boosted extract — but the extract depressurises a sealed cabin to 106–140 Pa and reverses the flue by −130 Pa (verificacion-ventilacion.md)
Bounded by C ≤ E/Q at 3.6–36 Bq/m³ on ordinary ground; alum shale at 300 mBq/(m²·s) breaks it at 216 (verificacion-radon.md)

The prescriptive route describes a floor on the ground. This one sits on a ventilated void over the chassis, so the route describes a detail the building does not contain — which is why the bound, not a membrane, is the instrument
The requirement is a function; 0.510 is the minimum LT that delivers the required glass area, so it is the project's instrument and it moves with the frame factor (verificacion-luz-diurna.md)

rows.closed_by: the barrier product and the junction detail
rows.evidence: A function in the forskrift; 10 m is the project's instrument. Its continuity is the floor-to-wall junction, where the steel crosses the plane when it is not wrapped (detalle-encuentro-R0.svg)
Not analysed. The envelope and junction screens cover the fabric; the comfort quantity needs the heating system, which is not chosen
A bathroom is in the R0 plan; the wet-room build-up is not designed

rows.closed_by: a timber fraction below 15 %, or more wool
rows.evidence: 189 mm gives 0.2202 against 0.2200 — solved *to* the limit, so the margin is zero by construction and the band across 8–23 % changes sign
278 mm at 15 %; clear field passes, studs do not. Solved to the limit like the wall (verificacion-envolvente.md)
281 mm at 15 %; same construction as the roof
No glazing selected. This is the row that also holds the daylight and the escape-window deficits, so one product decision moves three

rows.closed_by: the measurement itself — the test is specified, not performed
rows.evidence: Used as a design value by the ventilation and radon screens. The test is now specified (especificacion-ensayo-tetthet.md) but no measurement exists, and the standard that defines the method is not held (S031)
The chimney chain is checked; the draught it produces is the negative margin in row 14, which a room-sealed stove removes
+940 mm on the sewer route, −160 mm on a shallow sealed tank. The 0.90 m is a minimum burial depth, not a clearance
A specification item; no distribution system is designed

rows.value: must exist at ferdigattest, ajour, as built
rows.evidence: §4-1(2)'s exemption is rejected for this building (6 of 6 categories). §4-2 puts the duty to keep it updated on the owner, and a cabin that moves meets that condition routinely
The figure sits in §14-2's route, exempt via §14-5(1). At 18 m² it implies a mean Ψ of 0.0147 W/mK, under half of good practice, so it is not adoptable as a target (verificacion-puentes-termicas.md)

rows.status: met at the limit, no margin
rows.evidence: Not a TEK17 ytelse at all — a road-transport constraint from Directive 96/53/EC. Every R2 option was solved *to* it, so it has no margin
A project allowance, not a regulatory number; it destroys two of the four R2 options
A project choice above the flood datum. The class is the margin; the freeboard is a decision
Governed by the lift plan and the equipment's rated capacity, not by TEK17. No mass inventory exists, so no tension can be stated
A partial factor on the slope-stability model, not a margin on the F2/S2 class; applying it as one double-counts
